'''Kel Plath''' is a location in [[Sodonna]]. New owners of Kel Plath renamed it '''River Gardens'''. Kel Plath was a commonal, meaning it was a walled and gated enclosure with residences and a common green space inside. A [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] guarded the gate. There was [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] writing on the walls near the front gate. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]] visited here in search of Fallanassi.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />
